facts.text: Under the Concordia Promise Program, newly admitted FAFSA-eligible students with an Adjusted Gross Income under $90,000 receive full tuition coverage.

sources.title: Concordia Scholarships
sources.quote: Since Fall 2024, the Concordia Promise Program has covered full tuition for any student eligible to file the FAFSA and newly admitted to Concordia College with an Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) under $90,000.
